interpretation.quality: Context knownMean copied from existing arithmetic; known/planned coverage explicit. SWE true/false/unknown retains all planned denominators.
interpretation.tokens: SWE only; within the same model/split/task, both ordinary and treatment must be attempt-completed, official completed resolved=true, exact provider usage and known totalTokens. Ratio is treatment matched sum / ordinary matched sum. No cross-model token comparison.
interpretation.sensitivities: Remove whole named task setting across all three arms and all four models; rerun existing panel() arithmetic on retained rows. Preserve nulls/coverage and matched token eligibility. All duration inputs remain masked in this quality sensitivity channel.
interpretation.timing: Seven original clocks retained per condition/model/cohort/split; no pooled time macro. Cross-condition/mode/concurrency pair ratios remain null; rolling value is per-cell observed maximum overlap.
